title: Intelligent Interactive Systems
description: The Intelligent Interactive Systems group at the University of Cambridge designs, builds and studies interactive systems that make people more creative, expressive and satisfied.
dept: Department of Engineering · University of Cambridge
lede: We design, build and study interactive systems that make people more creative, expressive and satisfied, and that amplify how efficiently they work with computers.
address: Led by Professor Per Ola Kristensson, Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge, Cambridge CB2 1PZ.
joinText: The group welcomes enthusiastic PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, and a range of PhD projects is available.
